Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

SPECIFICATION FOR 
RECEPTACLE, WASTE

1. Scope — Dimensions and other requirements of waste receptacle for use in iiospitajs. 

2. Material 

2.1 Outer Pa// or Container — Mild steel either cold rolled or hot rolled quality as specifid in 2.2 (a) 
of 15:4033-1968 'General requirements Tor hospital furniture' or aluminium alloy of Designation 
HS20 or HS30 in WP condition as per 15:737-1965 'Specification for wrought aluminium and 
aluminium alloys, sheet and strip (for general engineering purposes) . 

ft 

2.2 fnner Pail {Removable ) — Shall be made of materials given in 2.1 or of high density polyethelene. 
The inner pail shall also be made from galvanized steel sheet in accordance with 15:277-1969 
'Specification for galvanized steel sheets (plain and corrugated) {second revision) . 

2.3 Gas/ref — Rubber, free from tackiness and chemically inactive to the action of mild acids and 
alkalies. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As given in Fig. 1. 

4. Manufacture and Workmanship 

4.1 The two ends of the sheet for the body shall be joined either by butt welding or by a lock joint. 
The width of the seam lock shall be not less than 12 mm. 

4.2 The bottom shall be pressed and joined to the body either by a lap welding or by a lock joint. 

4.3 The top rim of the body of the outer pail shall be uniformally beaded with or without a wire. 

4.4 The lid shall be pressed out of a sheet and shall be of such a construction that it shall not buckel, 
warp or twist permanently under normal working conditioris. 

4.5 The lid shall be joined to the pedal mechanism through links {see Fig. 1 ) meant to open or close 
the lid. It shall open by the srngle press of pedal mechanism to 80 to 85° from its closed position. 

4.6 For receiving the removable inner pail, 3 brackets (equally spaced) shall befitted inside the body 
of the outer pail. 

4.7 In the case of inner pail two ears shall be fitted to the top of the rim by means of the rivets. The 
ears shall be drilled to receive the handle. 

4.8 The ends of the handle shall be bent as shown in Fig, 2. 

4.9 In addition, the entire waste receptacle shall satisfy the requirements given in 4.1 of 15:4033-1968. 

5. Finish — The outer pail if made of mild steel shall be painted as specified in 5 of 15:4033-1968. 
The inner pail if made of mild steel shall be galvanized in accordance with IS: 1573-1970 'Specifica- 
tion for electroplated coatings for zinc on iron and steel {ftrft revision)' or 15:4759-1968 
'Specification for hot-dip zinc coatings on structural steel and other allied products'. In case of 
aluminium it shall be anodized in accordance with tS : 1868-1968 'Specification for anodic coatings 
on aluminium {first revision ) '. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Adtiesion Test — for painted parts the tests shaM be conducted as in 6.1.1 of 15:4033-1968. 

7. Marking — Shall be as specified in 7 of IS : 4033-1968. 

8. Packing — Shall be as specified in 8 of IS : 4033-1 968.
